title: Organon & Co. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: Organon & Co. (NYSE: OGN) filed an 8-K on April 26, 2026 disclosing the execution of a Merger Agreement with Sun Pharmaceutical Holdings USA, Inc. Under the terms, Sun Pharma will acquire all outstanding Organon shares at $14.00 per share in cash, representing a 103% premium to the April 9, 2026 closing price. Merger Sub will merge into Organon, with Organon surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent.
key_points: Organon & Co. entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Sun Pharmaceutical Holdings USA, Inc. on April 26, 2026.
Per share merger consideration is $14.00 in cash, representing a 103% premium to the closing share price on April 9, 2026.
Merger Sub (Sun Pharma America, Inc.) will merge with and into the Company, with Organon continuing as the surviving corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of Parent.
Parent has obtained committed debt financing sufficient to fund the per share merger consideration and refinance certain existing debt of the Company upon closing.
Outstanding options, restricted stock units (Pre-2026 and Other), and performance stock units are subject to specific cancellation/conversion provisions at the Effective Time.
The transaction was preceded by a media report on April 10, 2026 speculating about a potential transaction with Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited.
